target: creusot-std std::partial_eq byte/Int sequence equality transport

commands.proof_execution: require_escalated; wrapper lock; one solver; 1024 MiB per prover

scope.relation: Seq<u8>::eq_model(Seq<Int>) iff equality of the byte sequence with the paired Seq<u8> view
scope.assumptions: The RHS byte view and RHS integer deep model have equal lengths and pointwise equal numeric values. No equality-of-length precondition is placed between left and right operands.
scope.body: Source-bodied opaque logic certificate. It bridges u8 sequence Eq model semantics with exact Seq<u8> equality; no trusted axiom was added.
scope.caller: HeaderValue PartialEq<str> uses the real Bytes equality and str::as_bytes bodies/contracts, then this certificate to prove its existing UTF-8 byte model postcondition.
